title: wins and gems
script:
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
   Name = "sxlnxcy hub - Train to be the Fastest",
   Icon = 0,
   LoadingTitle = "Loading...",
   LoadingSubtitle = "by sxlnxcy",
   ShowText = "Rayfield",
   Theme = "Ocean",
   ToggleUIKeybind = "K",
   ConfigurationSaving = { Enabled = true, FileName = "TrainFastestHub" },
   KeySystem = false
})

Rayfield:Notify({
   Title = "sxlnxcy hub",
   Content = "Auto Farm Race FIXED & WORKING! Auto wins all stages",
   Duration = 6
})

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local stages = {
   Workspace.Teleporters.Stage1,
   Workspace.Teleporters.Stage2,
   Workspace.Teleporters.Stage3,
   Workspace.Teleporters.Stage4,
   Workspace.Teleporters.Stage5,
   Workspace.Teleporters.Stage6,
   Workspace.Teleporters.Stage7,
   Workspace.Teleporters.Stage8,
   Workspace.Teleporters.Stage9,
   Workspace.Teleporters.Stage10,
   Workspace.Teleporters.Stage11,
   Workspace.Teleporters.Stage12,
   Workspace.Teleporters.Stage13,
   Workspace.Teleporters.Stage14,
   Workspace.Teleporters.Stage15,
   Workspace.Teleporters.Stage16
}

local Teleporters = workspace.Teleporters

local Tab = Window:CreateTab("Auto Race Farm", nil)

local autoWinEnabled = false

Tab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Auto Win All Races (ON/OFF)",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(state)
      autoWinEnabled = state
      
      if autoWinEnabled then
         spawn(function()
            while autoWinEnabled do
               for _, stage in ipairs(stages) do
                  local winPart = stage:FindFirstChild("WinPart")
                  if winPart then
                     pcall(function()
                        hrp.CFrame = winPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
                        firetouchinterest(hrp, winPart, 0)
                        task.wait(0.05)
                        firetouchinterest(hrp, winPart, 1)
                     end)
                     task.wait(0.1)
                  end
               end
               task.wait(1) -- Delay between full races
            end
         end)
         Rayfield:Notify({ Title = "Auto Win", Content = "ON - Winning races non-stop!", Duration = 5 })
      else
         Rayfield:Notify({ Title = "Auto Win", Content = "OFF", Duration = 3 })
      end
   end,
})

Tab:CreateButton({
   Name = "Instant Win One Race (All Stages)",
   Callback = function()
      for _, stage in ipairs(stages) do
         local winPart = stage:FindFirstChild("WinPart")
         if winPart then
            pcall(function()
               hrp.CFrame = winPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
               firetouchinterest(hrp, winPart, 0)
               task.wait(0.02)
               firetouchinterest(hrp, winPart, 1)
            end)
            task.wait(0.05)
         end
      end
      Rayfield:Notify({ Title = "Instant Win", Content = "Completed full race!", Duration = 6 })
   end,
})

Tab:CreateButton({
   Name = "Teleport to Stage 1",
   Callback = function()
      local stage1 = Teleporters:FindFirstChild("Stage1")
      if stage1 then
         local winPart = stage1:FindFirstChild("WinPart")
         if winPart then
            hrp.CFrame = winPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 10, 0)
         end
      end
   end,
})
